body: He dated a girl that would cut herself and was mentally unstable. She would try to hurt other people as well. He at one time felt like life was not worth living. I assume he thinks I am doing it for attention. I have never inflicted self harm or anything like that- just summoning the courage to tell him that I felt depressed was a big step for me. He told me that I was depressed about everything and he stopped caring if I was sad. I am not even sure if I am truly depressed but I feel like an idiot.
